as_told.title: SAIC remote viewing and crash retrieval

plain: SAIC (Science Applications International Corporation), a defence contractor based in Reston, Virginia, has openly studied exotic propulsion, anti-gravity, directed-energy weapons and other fringe science, Michels says, and seems to have worked hand in hand with Stargate, the CIA's psychic spy programme, carrying on "remote viewing" work, the attempt to see distant places with the mind, that it took over from the CIA. Michels tells this himself, calling it "all public information", and on a later episode adds that a former US intelligence chief named Bobby Ray Inman sat on the company's board and that SAIC "seemed to possibly be involved" with retrieving crashed UFOs. If true, a private contractor would sit where psychic research, exotic physics and UFO recovery meet.
